notes.title: Sky Mirror · Strolling officially released!
notes.notes:
We are glad to see the game is officially available on Steam.

It is a mix of adventure game, puzzle game and flying game, inspired from Uyuni Salt Flat in Bolivia, South America. There are 70 levels, and more than 5 game mechanics including timing, puzzle solving, left right brain training, mirror reflection and dodging.
